verdict.rationale: Apple publishes the two specs the story asks about: up to 64GB of unified memory and 273GB/s of memory bandwidth. It also claims LLMs run smoothly on device and offers MLX and Metal/PyTorch backends for running models on Apple Silicon. A quantized 70B model would fit within 64GB only tightly, and nothing in the pack shows 70B-class inference actually running or how fast it is. missing for 10: explicit evidence that a 70B-class quantized model runs, measured tokens/sec or other hands-on benchmarks, independent corroboration of practical inference speed, headroom beyond the 64GB cap.
